No, not all of it. Of the 81.3 ha of 2021 tree-cover loss (2.23% of the asset), about 68.1 ha (~84%) fell in planted pine (*Pinus elliottii* and *P. taeda*) according to the 2021 national forest map. The remaining 13.2 ha (~16%) lies outside mapped forest. None of the loss was in native forest.

The JRC 2020 reference maps 98% of the event area as forest, so that 13.2 ha was probably tree-covered in 2020. It may have been a plantation not captured in the 2021 map, or a boundary mismatch. The tool output doesn't say which.
